name: Angular Blur
description: Radial motion blur rotating around a center point

name: Arc
description: Pie sector (arc wedge) with adjustable radius and aperture angle

name: Ascii
description: Convert imagery to ASCII character art

name: Aurora
description: Mesmerizing aurora borealis with layered curtains, vertical rays, and flowing light.

name: Barn Doors
description: Split the content along a center line and wipe outward in both directions

name: Bar Shift
description: Slices content into parallel bars, each offset independently for a fractured or glitch-like effect

name: Beam
description: A beam of light from one point to another.

name: Bend
description: Bends the ends of the frame toward you like a curved display — content at the edges swells closer under real perspective, or curls away when the strength goes negative

name: Blob
description: Organic animated blob with 3D lighting and gradients

name: Block Dissolve
description: Dissolve the content away as a grid of blocks vanishing in random order

name: Block Noise
description: Blocky value noise with soft cells that morph over time

name: Blue Noise
description: High-frequency blue noise — even, grainy speckle ideal for dithering

name: Blur
description: A simple Gaussian blur effect

name: Boids
description: A living murmuration of hundreds of flocking agents drawn as crisp arrows, streaks, dots or glowing comets — separation, alignment and cohesion drive fluid, splitting-and-merging ribbons, agents flash toward an excited color when scattered, and the cursor acts as an attractor or a predator

name: Bokeh Blur
description: Photographic lens blur where bright highlights bloom into aperture-shaped discs

name: Brick Pattern
description: Classic brick wall pattern with alternating rows and mortar gaps

name: Brightness Contrast
description: Adjust brightness and contrast of the image

name: Brushed Metal
description: Photorealistic brushed metal — a satin anodised surface combed with fine directional grain that smears the reflected studio and key light into the long anisotropic streaks of real brushed aluminium, steel, gold or copper

name: Bulge
description: Magnify or pinch content around a center point

name: Carbon Fiber
description: Photorealistic woven carbon fibre — interlaced tows whose anisotropic sheen flips ninety degrees cell to cell, raised into a quilted weave and finished with a glossy clearcoat that mirrors the studio. Plain or twill, in any shape.

name: Chalkboard
description: Renders content as a chalk drawing on a blackboard, with edge strokes and cross-hatch shading

name: Channel Blur
description: Independent blur for red, green, and blue channels

name: Checkerboard
description: Classic checkerboard pattern with two alternating colors

name: Checker Wipe
description: Wipe the content away as a checkerboard of fading squares

name: Chevron
description: Animated chevron / zigzag stripe pattern

name: Chroma Flow
description: Interactive liquid flow effect that follows your cursor

name: Chromatic Aberration
description: Separate RGB channels for a prismatic distortion effect

name: Chrome
description: Studio-lit mirror chrome — a precision-machined shape with a controllable polished bevel, softly convex faces and a photographic studio reflected in them: one huge frontal softbox, black flags, and thin warm/cool strip lights that fringe amber and ice-blue exactly where the reflections break

name: Circle
description: Generate a circle with adjustable size and softness

name: Color Wheel
description: A directional gradient that smoothly cycles through rainbow colors or a custom set of three colors

name: Compression Artifacts
description: Simulates lossy JPEG compression — 8×8 DCT block quantization, blockiness, ringing and color bleed

name: Concentric Spin
description: Concentric rings that each rotate the underlying image by different amounts

name: Conic Gradient
description: Colors sweep in a full circle around a center point, like a color wheel

name: Contour Lines
description: Draw topographical contour lines based on luminance or alpha

name: Corner Pin
description: Pin each corner of the content to an arbitrary position for a free perspective warp

name: Crescent
description: Crescent moon shape — an outer circle with an inner circle subtracted

name: Cross
description: Plus / cross shape with adjustable arm length, width, and rounding

name: CRTScreen
description: Retro CRT monitor simulation with scanlines

name: Crystal
description: Diamond-like crystal lens with faceted refraction.

name: Curl Noise
description: Swirling divergence-free flow field that drifts over time

name: Cursor Ripples
description: Fluid-like ripple distortion

name: Cursor Trail
description: Animated trail effect that tracks cursor movement

name: Data Mosh
description: Corrupted-codec motion smearing — macroblocks lock in place and drag their pixels across the frame in liquid trails, each recovering on its own clock, like a video stream that lost its keyframes

name: Diamond Gradient
description: Diamond-shaped gradient radiating from a center point using Manhattan distance

name: Diamond Wipe
description: Wipe the content away through a lattice of growing diamonds

name: Diffuse Blur
description: Grain-like pixel displacement at random

name: Displacement Map
description: Distorts child content using another layer's pixels as a displacement map

name: Dither
description: Dithering effect with multiple pattern options

name: Dot Grid
description: Grid of dots with optional twinkling animation

name: Drop Shadow
description: Adds a soft shadow behind the child content based on its alpha silhouette

name: Duotone
description: Map colors to two tones based on luminance

name: Ellipse
description: Ellipse with independently adjustable horizontal and vertical radii

name: Emboss
description: Embossed / debossed relief shading on top of child content, driven by a custom shape

name: Engraving
description: Copper-plate line engraving — the image is redrawn as flowing line work whose weight swells with darkness, lines displaced by the form like a banknote portrait: a single plate, cross-hatched shadow plates, or one continuous spiral cut

name: Erosion Noise
description: Branching, hydraulic-erosion ridges carved into noise

name: Exposure
description: Multiplicative exposure (gain) on the child. Unlike additive brightness, it scales values around black — blacks stay black while highlights can be pushed past 1.0 to feed HDR bloom and tone-mapping roll-off. Pointwise, so no extra render pass is needed.

name: Falling Lines
description: Directional falling lines with a leading-to-trailing color fade

name: Film Grain
description: Analog film grain texture overlay, weighted toward darker areas

name: Film Stock
description: Real analog film color from measured film-emulation LUTs — ten classic stock looks with emulsion halation and projector gate weave

name: Flip
description: Mirror content horizontally, vertically, or both

name: Floating Particles
description: Drifting, twinkling motes — thousands of real simulated particles floating in a shared heading with per-particle wander and variance, and a cursor that stirs the field with a gust that settles back into the drift

name: Flower
description: Petal shape with N lobes and adjustable inner-to-outer radius ratio

name: Flow Field
description: Fluid-like distortion with constant smooth motion

name: Flowing Gradient
description: Liquid silk gradient with organic flowing color bands

name: Fluted Glass
description: Full-screen fluted glass effect — refracts content through repeating cylindrical bars

name: Fog
description: Fog that fills the screen and interacts with the mouse

name: Form3 D
description: Wraps child content onto a 3D raymarched shape with lighting.

name: Fractal Noise
description: Multi-octave fractal Brownian motion noise texture with true noise evolution

name: Frost
description: Photoreal frozen ice — thickness-driven subsurface scattering that reads as a solid block, with fine frost crystals creeping in from the edges

name: Gabor Noise
description: Oriented sine-grain noise with a fingerprint-like flow

name: Glass
description: Optically realistic glass lens driven in a custom shape

name: Glass Tiles
description: Refraction-like distortion in a tile grid pattern

name: Glitch
description: Digital glitch that melts pixels and distorts colors

name: Glow
description: Soft glow effect with adjustable intensity

name: Godrays
description: Volumetric light rays emanating from a point

name: Goo
description: Photoreal wet liquid — animated 3D metaball blobs that merge and bulge to loosely form the shape, with sliding wet highlights, a clearcoat rim and a translucent body

name: Gradient Map
description: Maps source luminance through an animated color gradient (Photoshop-style gradient map)

name: Grayscale
description: Convert colors to black and white

name: Grid
description: Simple grid lines pattern with adjustable thickness and rotation

name: Grid Distortion
description: Interactive grid distortion controlled by mouse position

name: Group
description: Container for organizing and composing child effects — supports flex-like flow layout (column/row stacking via the flow prop)
infrastructure: Use Design Lab layer groups to compose effects.

name: Halftone
description: Halftone dot pattern effect for printing aesthetics

name: Heart
description: Heart shape with adjustable size

name: Heatmap
description: Thermal-camera heat flowing through any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.

name: Hex Grid
description: Honeycomb hexagonal grid pattern

name: Hologram
description: Volumetric sci-fi hologram — a translucent emissive projection of the shape with fresnel-lit edges, depth scan-lines that wrap 3D forms, CRT scanlines, flicker and beam wobble

name: Holographic
description: Iridescent holographic foil sticker with animated rainbow sheen and glitter flakes

name: HTMLIn Canvas
description: Render live HTML/DOM content as a WebGPU texture layer via the html-in-canvas API. Requires Chrome Canary with chrome://flags/#canvas-draw-element enabled.
infrastructure: Experimental Chrome-only DOM capture; use Design Lab text and image layers.

name: Hue Shift
description: Rotate hue around the color wheel

name: Image Texture
description: Display an image with customizable object-fit modes

name: Ink Flow
description: Drag to paint swirling ribbons of ink through a real fluid field — eddies keep evolving after you let go

name: Invert
description: Invert RGB colors while preserving alpha

name: Iris Wipe
description: Reveal through an expanding circle growing from a center point

name: Irradiance
description: Photorealistic light spilling around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape — any number of movable colored point lights strike the silhouette and the lit edges irradiate their surroundings, gathered in a compute pass with real cast shadows, mixing where they meet and burning to white at the rim

name: Isometric Cubes
description: Isometric tumbling-blocks tiling — a 3D cube illusion (rhombille pattern)

name: Kaleidoscope
description: Create a kaleidoscope effect with radial mirrored segments

name: Key Frames
description: Motion-tracking overlay — trackers hunt and follow features in the content, dropping keyframe diamonds behind them along their motion paths, like a compositor mid-track

name: Lens Distortion
description: Split content into shifting chromatic layers with barrel or pincushion lens warp. Powered by Paper Shaders.

name: Lens Flare
description: Realistic camera lens flare with artifacts.

name: Light Edge
description: Glowing, pulsing light racing around the edge of any 2D, SVG, or 3D shape. Powered by Paper Shaders.

name: Light Leak
description: Photorealistic film light leak — warm overexposed light bleeding in from a draggable anchor point, with streak bands, chromatic fringing, and slow breathing that evolves over time

name: Line
description: Draw a straight line between two points with color, thickness, and solid, dashed, or dotted styles

name: Linear Blur
description: Directional motion blur in a specific angle

name: Linear Gradient
description: Create smooth linear color gradients

name: Linear Wipe
description: Wipe the content away along a straight edge with a soft feathered transition

name: Liquid Metal
description: Flowing liquid chrome — a molten reflective surface that wraps the shape, sweeping a procedural studio reflection across animated folds with crisp speculars and prismatic edges

name: Liquify
description: Liquid-like interactive deformation effect

name: Magnetic Filings
description: Thousands of tiny iron filings scattered on paper that swing to align with a magnetic field around the cursor, tracing out the field lines — a dipole whose axis follows the cursor's motion draws the classic two-lobed swirl, and every sweep of the magnet sends a glowing wave of filings flipping and settling

name: Marble
description: Classic marble swirl and vein texture using noise-warped sine waves

name: Mesh Gradient
description: Flowing mesh gradient of soft drifting color swaths whose seams wrap through the palette

name: Mirror
description: Mirror content across a line defined by center point and angle

name: Multi Point Gradient
description: Five individually placed color points blended together by proximity — drag each point to shape the gradient

name: Nebula
description: A volumetric gas nebula sealed inside polished glass; billowing emission clouds with hollow dark cavities and hot glowing cores, star fields drifting at real depth behind the gas, all refracted through the curved walls of the shape and dressed with studio reflections

name: Neon
description: Photorealistic neon tube / 3D pipe effect driven by a custom shape

name: Noise Dissolve
description: Dissolve the content away through an organic noise pattern

name: Object Tracker
description: Computer-vision style object detection overlay — draws bounding boxes and labels around detected regions of the content below, with grid, quadtree and mosaic layouts.

name: Obsidian
description: Dark tinted glass whose faces stay near-black while every surface turning away from the viewer ignites with a flowing iridescent gradient — vivid color living only on the oblique walls and bevels

name: Page Peel
description: Curl the content up from a corner like a peeling page

name: Paper
description: Applies realistic paper grain and surface roughness to child content

name: Parallelogram
description: Parallelogram with adjustable width, height and skew

name: Particle Field
description: Explodes the child content into a breathing 3D field of particles — bright areas float toward you and dark areas recede, the whole relief can be orbited with the camera rotations, and the cursor physically throws particles that spring back home

name: Particle Flow
description: Thousands of drifting dust particles carried by a real incompressible fluid field the cursor stirs — drag to plow a wake and the particles ride the eddies and vortices it leaves behind, while a gentle ambient breeze keeps the whole scene breathing on its own

name: Particles
description: A swarm of simulated particles that settles into the shape, filling it evenly — flat, SVG or true 3D volumes — scattering from the cursor (or chasing it), tumbling when the shape moves, and always drifting back home

name: Perlin Noise
description: Smooth gradient noise that morphs over time

name: Perspective
description: Rotate the plane in 3D space with pan and tilt

name: Pixelate
description: Pixelation effect with adjustable cell size

name: Pixel Sort
description: Pixels sort by brightness around the cursor and keep their sorted position, optionally decaying back over time

name: Pixel Throw
description: Throws pixels along the cursor's path like a fluid — brighter (or redder/greener/bluer) pixels are flung farther, then settle back with friction

name: Plasma
description: Animated effect of glowing plasma

name: Plastic
description: Glossy molded plastic with photorealistic studio reflections, driven in a custom shape

name: Polar Coordinates
description: Convert rectangular coordinates to polar space

name: Polygon
description: Regular polygon with adjustable sides and corner rounding

name: Posterize
description: Reduce color depth to create a poster effect

name: Prism
description: A beam of light that fans out and splits into a slowly-rotating rainbow past a controllable point. Transparent background — composite over a dark layer.

name: Progressive Blur
description: Blur that increases progressively in one direction

name: Radial Gradient
description: Radial gradient radiating from a center point

name: Radial Wipe
description: Sweep the content away in a clock-hand arc around a center point

name: Random Bars
description: Wipe the content away as parallel bars vanishing in random order

name: Reaction Diffusion
description: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion pattern that fills the layer and blooms wherever you drag the cursor

name: Rectangular Coordinates
description: Convert polar coordinates back to rectangular space

name: Reflective Plane
description: Reflective floor that mirrors the content above it

name: Repeater
description: Repeat the child content in grid, radial or linear layouts with per-instance variation

name: Ring
description: Annular ring (donut) with adjustable radius and band thickness

name: Ripples
description: Concentric animated ripples emanating from a point

name: Ripple Wipe
description: Wipe the content away in concentric rings pulsing out from a center point

name: Rounded Rect
description: Rounded rectangle with adjustable width, height, and corner rounding

name: Saturation
description: Adjust color saturation intensity

name: Scratches
description: Fine hairline scratches, like a worn film or scratched surface

name: Sharpness
description: Adjust image sharpness using a convolution kernel

name: Shatter
description: Broken glass effect with tectonic plate displacement

name: Simplex Noise
description: Organic noise with animated movement

name: Sine Wave
description: Animated wave with thickness and softness

name: Slice Wipe
description: Slice the content into strips that slide away in alternating directions

name: Smoke
description: Realistic fluid smoke simulation with vorticity dynamics

name: Smoke Fill
description: Fill a shape with swirling fluid smoke that interacts with the shape boundary

name: Smoke Flow
description: Cursor-driven smoke that lingers, swirls, and dissipates with fluid dynamics

name: Solarize
description: Inverts tones above a luminance threshold — a classic darkroom and photo effect

name: Solid Color
description: Fill the canvas with a single solid color

name: Sparkle
description: Twinkling star glints over the bright parts of the layer inside

name: Spherize
description: Map content onto a 3D sphere surface with depth distortion

name: Spiral
description: Rotating spiral pattern with animated movement

name: Star
description: Classic star polygon with straight sides and sharp pointed tips

name: Stone
description: Applies a marbled stone relief and surface distortion to child content

name: Strands
description: Flowing ribbons of light with a multi-color gradient

name: Stretch
description: Stretch content towards a direction from a center point

name: Stripes
description: Alternating colored stripes with animation

name: Studio Background
description: Multi-light studio background with ambient motion.

name: Sun Burst
description: Radial sunburst rays emanating from a center point

name: Surface3 D
description: Drapes child content over a 3D wave surface with perspective and lighting

name: Swirl
description: Flowing swirl pattern with multi-layered noise

name: Teardrop
description: Teardrop — a rounded bulb tapering to a sharp point

name: Text
description: Text with any Google font — multi-line with wrapping, alignment and line height — rendered crisp via a glyph texture

name: Thin Film
description: Iridescent thin-film edge

name: Tilt Shift
description: Selective focus blur mimicking tilt-shift photography

name: Time Trail
description: An Echo-style temporal trail — whatever moves sheds a smooth, decaying long-exposure ghost trail (frame-difference Motion mode works on opaque images and video; Alpha mode trails a shape's coverage), with optional zoom-feedback tunnels and rainbow light-painting

name: Tint
description: Apply a color tint to the image

name: Trapezoid
description: Trapezoid with adjustable top and bottom widths and height

name: Triangular Grid
description: Tiling grid of equilateral triangles with optional animated row offsets

name: Tritone
description: Map colors to three tones: shadows, midtones, highlights

name: Truchet
description: Quarter-circle arc tiles that connect to form organic, maze-like flowing curves

name: Twirl
description: Rotate and twist content around a center point

name: Venetian Blinds
description: Wipe the content away behind a set of parallel closing strips

name: Vesica
description: Vesica piscis (lens shape) formed by the intersection of two overlapping circles

name: VHS
description: Analog VHS tape with intermittent tape damage, chroma bleed, and per-scanline noise

name: Vibrance
description: Selective saturation adjustment protecting skin tones

name: Video Texture
description: Display a video with customizable playback and object-fit modes
infrastructure: Video input is a media source, not a standalone material.

name: Vignette
description: Darkens or tints the edges of the frame, drawing attention toward the center

name: Voronoi
description: Cellular pattern where each pixel is colored by its distance to the nearest of many scattered points

name: Voxels
description: Rebuild any shape out of voxels — a flat shape becomes chunky pixel art, a 3D shape a lit voxel model with smooth ambient occlusion, cast shadows, a key light you can orbit or drive, and per-cube color

name: Water
description: Translucent water — a refractive, light-absorbing body that deepens to its color with thickness, wrapped in a wind-driven wave surface that reflects a procedural sky, with Fresnel-bright grazing edges and foam breaking on the crests and shoreline

name: Watercolor
description: Painterly watercolor look — Kuwahara flattening, pigment edge darkening, paper grain and bleeding

name: Wave Distortion
description: Wave-based distortion with multiple waveform types

name: Waveform
description: Audio-visualizer waveform — equalizer bars, a filled wave, an oscilloscope line, or a dot matrix — driven by a simulated signal whose amplitude you can map to your own audio level

name: Wavelet Noise
description: Rotating banded wavelets that ripple as they animate

name: Weave
description: Interlaced textile weave pattern with two thread colors going over and under each other

name: Webcam Texture
description: Display a live webcam feed with customizable object-fit modes
infrastructure: Camera capture is not enabled by selecting a material.

name: Wool
description: Applies an interwoven fibrous fabric texture and distortion to child content

name: Worley Noise
description: Cellular noise field — distance-based, with selectable feature combinations and fractal octaves

name: Zoom Blur
description: Radial zoom blur expanding from a center point
